approved_architecture_decisions: Use the reviewed Git-installed runtime release phase2-promotion-v27-1f12855-git at source commit 1f1285577c354f2f25e2fe79e1b57be7fa378c40.
Treat the same Linux user and control-plane account as trusted authority; malicious same-user swap-and-restore during recomputation is outside the threat model.
Fail closed for ordinary authority drift, missing or extra files, symlinks, special files, path escape, size drift, mode drift, and content drift.
Allow host network sharing only for registered real provider launches whose immutable protocol declares provider_access.
Inject only credential-free numeric-loopback HTTP proxy URLs into provider launches; remove all proxy variables from canary probes and trusted evaluator execution.
Do not inherit the outer AGENTTEAM_LAUNCHER_SELECTION when direct or full experiment adapters launch their nested runtime.
Persist the experiment run ID, run-manifest digest, target-path digest, and controller reference in scheduler state so operator stop validates against the real ledger.
Derive a controller-only run's initial integration baseline from the frozen taskpack runtime release source commit unless the caller supplies an explicit baseline.

Stage provider-readable repo and role context plus the provider result file inside the independent attempt workspace before sealing the sandbox source authority, while keeping those files outside the business Git diff.

Give the normal worker outbox a bounded two-second publication-priority window after observing a provider terminal, while interrupted resume and lease-expired orphan recovery remain immediately recoverable and fail closed.
Mount only the selected Codex 0.145.0 binary, bounded authentication file, sanitized configuration, required system runtime paths, DNS files, and TLS certificates.
Bind the live protocol to model gpt-5.6-sol, medium reasoning, a 600000-token global budget, a 7200-second wall-time budget, and one in-flight provider invocation.
Run P2-08 before P2-09 and P2-10, and require exact current epoch-bound operator authorization before P2-09 may launch any provider.
Use the preregistered deterministic L1 taskpack only in agentteam_direct mode and keep it unavailable to agentteam_full mode.
Do not automatically merge to main or push; P2-10 may only create the reviewed finalization child commit after accepted live evidence and full verification.

Keep the P2-08 capability registry strict and fail closed; the approved blueprint declares registry version phase2_readiness_capability_registry.v1 and materialization generates the exact test IDs, Git artifact paths, and blob digests from the candidate source commit.
Bind contract.protocol_sha256 to the canonical JSON digest of the resolved protocol template and reject mismatches during blueprint materialization before freezing or provider authorization.

Do not publish pre-provider or post-integration boundary observations while an experiment attempt remains inflight; retry transient provider-lane lock contention for at most 250 milliseconds while retaining fail-closed denial for a genuinely occupied lane.
Start both provider and evaluator source-guard Python processes with -B so live execution cannot add bytecode files to the immutable Git-installed runtime release.

Keep a stable Python source-guard as the transient service main process, launch and wait for the sandbox command as its child, and retain KillMode=control-group so completion no longer depends on direct sandbox-main or empty-cgroup inotify observation while timeout, nonzero exit, and descendant cleanup still fail closed.

Use the immutable protocol acceptance argv for final integration verification in both AgentTeam modes; permit the trusted override only with the controller-bound target project root, while ordinary taskpacks retain their own verification command.

Normalize only elapsed unittest duration and the random TemporaryDirectory segment in successful Git-init output before P2-10 replay digest comparison; preserve return code, test count, status, arbitrary repository paths, and failure text.
Derive the single live drift repeat from the first slot of repetition index 1 in the seeded counterbalanced order, and reject a mismatched blueprint or live action before any provider allocation.

Allow exactly one bounded repository-relative PYTHONPATH assignment before python -m unittest discover only for approved controller-only taskpacks; reject other variables, absolute paths, parent traversal, multi-path values, and changed command shapes.

When materialization fails after copying read-only authority, make only the private staging tree owner-writable for cleanup, preserve the original exception, and leave source and frozen authority permissions unchanged.

Before agentteam_full registers its taskpack-author provider invocation, validate and inject the immutable protocol acceptance argv as the authoritative verification profile; reject an unusable profile with zero provider calls while preserving normal model-authored decomposition and direct-taskpack isolation.
